body.statement: For the selective randomization \(p\)-value of Definition 1 in Freidling, Zhao, and Gao, with the auxiliary \(Z^*\) satisfying equations (5)--(7), Proposition 1 gives conditional superuniformity and selective type-I-error control; no imputability premise is required.

attestation.note: Directly checked arXiv:2405.07026v4 primary PDF on 2026-09-14. Definition 1 imposes equations (5)-(7); Proposition 1 states conditional superuniformity and the quoted consequence, with no imputability premise.
